Comment.value: Concerning Pipeweed strain (roadmap: concerning-pipeweed). Salvaged from the retired Dirty Hippie store: resref kept (already filed in the palette), retagged from witchbud to pw_witchweed to close the witchbud/item118 tag conflict, and the fabricated AddCost 32767 stripped back to a real 2000 gp. Keeps its Cast Spell: Grenade Chicken charges.

value.0:
Odo Proudfoot keeps this one under the counter, wrapped twice, and will not say where it came from or what field it grew in. It is not Shire leaf. It may not be leaf at all.

Smoked in a water pipe of the Smoking Chamber, the mind goes very clear and very fast, and every instinct that would ordinarily stop you goes quiet. It also does something with chickens that nobody has satisfactorily explained.

Intelligence +4, Wisdom -4, for one hour of real time. Resting will not clear it. Ten smokes to the pouch.
